newsitem.title: USA: Genesis estimates it has 66 pct of Imagex.
newsitem.headline: Genesis estimates it has 66 pct of Imagex.

text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said Wednesday that it believed it succeeded in gaining the 66 percent of Imagex stock it targeted in a conversion offer.
Genesis had offered to exchange one Genesis Insurance restricted share for each 6.25 Imagex shares.
Genesis spokeswoman Deborah Evans said the company could have definite tally of the percentage of shares accepting the offer as early as Thursday.
The offer expired October 11, Evans said, but Gensis may still purchase more Imagex shares or accept them for conversion on a case-by-case basis.
During the next 10 days Genesis will announce nominations for Imagex management positions and outline a reorganization plan for the company as its new subsidiary, the company said.
"It is our desire to implement our best efforts to bring revenue and growth back to the Imagex division," Genesis Chief Executive Mohamed Khairy Mohamed Zayed II said in a statement.
